text:
Location: Nui Ba Den

Not sure what is happening in this picture. It's hard to see. The building on the right with the window could be where we held sick call for the infantry of the Cambodians and their families. Captain Kennedy handled the political problems. Me and the medic handled the sick call. I called the medic Kiwi, he was a new Zealander. We went to Saigon together probably 15 times. We met Tototz down there all the time. I don't remember the medics name at all. Might have been Roger.

On the left is a rock or giant boulder.

No idea what those boxes are in the front center. Could be ammo but we never left ammo outside.

---
When I first got there (Nui Ba Den for the first time) with Gagne, I may have been in that building on the right and this Cambodian came in, that must have been in his 60s or 70s, he had a necklace of 30 human ears. We were talking to him. He was a chief that lived somewhere around the area of the mountain. We had a hard time communicate. We never saw him again. He could have been the head of the enemy for all I know. The callouses in front of his legs look like they were 3/8th thick. His feet had tumors and callouses. I never seen anything like that in my life and i never will again and I'll never forget it either. Why would you go around cutting someone's ears off?

---
I met some Thai soldiers that were different personalities. This may have been by the pool in Cholon.
